answer: Random mutual audit stops sybil farming. Each agent signs its claim with a cipher key, and every epoch a beacon picks three peer auditors to re-run it. An auditor who exposes a forgery slashes the cheater's 40 POA deposit and keeps half as bounty. An honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and threads its record through the ledger. Forging 1,000 identities means climbing a 40,000 POA cost ridge against a 30,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money.
